channels.purpose: Shared proof anchoring for procurement, delivery evidence, escrow, PLS, and export lifecycle events.
Export manifest proof and offline verification references.
PLS certificate, Shariah decision, and template-version proof references.

policies.lifecycleEndorsement: MAJORITY Admins by channel, or explicit consortium-approved signature policy before pilot.
policies.applicationReaders: Any channel member reader, narrowed per channel.
policies.applicationWriters: Platform operator plus transaction-side organization writer where applicable.

operations.certificateRotation: Rotate client identities with smoke query before submitter switch; revoke old identity after proof submit/query pass.
operations.chaincodeUpgrade: Increment sequence for endorsement or collection changes; increment version for binary change; keep previous JSON state readable.
operations.incidentHandling: Fabric outage must surface as proof unavailable/pending/failed and must not delete PostgreSQL business events.
operations.backupBoundary: Fabric ledger and MSP backups are environment-specific and not provided by this repository template.
